description: Call this when the user asks how much something costs (drain unblocking, toilet, sink, CCTV drain camera, thermal camera leak detection, boiler installation, pipe replacement, waterproofing …). Optionally pass the service or problem to filter. Returns the official indicative 'from' prices in EUR exactly as on https://kanalvarna.com/ceni/ plus how pricing works. The final price is always given by phone before work starts.

language.description: Language of the user's question: 'bg' (Bulgarian), 'en' (English), 'ru' (Russian) or 'de' (German; answers use English labels where no German text exists). If omitted it is detected from the text; default 'bg'.
language.title: Language

service.description: Optional service or problem to filter by, e.g. 'тоалетна', 'leak detection', 'бойлер'. Omit for the full price list.
service.title: Service

name: get_prices
title: Get Kanal Varna prices
